capabilities: Render a note's heading sections as editable, draggable cards
Switch between layouts including grid, calendar, day planner, heatmap, and dashboard
Nest, reorder, pin, color, and delete sections by drag and drop with undo
Flip two-faced cards for question-and-answer or flash-card use
Fill dated cards with events from an iCal calendar feed
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README's FAQ states it is vibe-coded, and a section discloses that network use is limited to downloading background images and fetching iCal feeds.
motivation: The author values keeping content in one plain Markdown file (an AI agent can read the whole context, any Markdown app can edit it) and built the plugin to remove the excessive-scrolling price that single large notes usually cost.
problem: Obsidian gives no graphical way to work on the sections of one large note, which otherwise demands excessive scrolling to find and edit them.

relations.evidence: Ticking a checkbox goes through Tasks, so recurring tasks spawn their next occurrence
it pairs nicely with Single File Daily Notes as well as Tasks
With the Style Settings plugin installed, Settings → Style Settings → Single File Section Cards offers visual knobs
Both Tasks-style 📅 2026-09-10 dates and Dataview [due:: 2026-09-10] fields count

summary: Card-wall view that renders a single note's heading sections as editable, reorderable cards, with grid, calendar, day-planner, and dashboard layouts.
